topic: How can we develop manufacturing systems on Mars?
key_answer: Develop Mars manufacturing through staged, resource-coupled cells for deliberately bounded non-critical products rather than a premature general-purpose factory. Each candidate must bind feedstock provenance, process route, environment-energy conditions, inspection-release logic, and a recovery route. A terrestrial simulant or local-material result supports only the level of claim justified by its cards; it does not by itself establish Mars deployment, human-rated qualification, self-sufficiency, or economic viability.
known_risks: All source landing pages and bibliographic records require human verification because the user-requested in-app browser could not complete NASA or DOI navigation under the current network policy.
Site-specific regolith, long-duration Mars environment, power architecture, dust, thermal behavior, maintenance, operations, and logistics are not resolved by terrestrial analog evidence.
No Mars operation, laboratory manufacturing campaign, simulator run, facility operation, or crew-critical qualification was executed; every MARS-CELL outcome remains conditional.
